name: Submission To Authority
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to submit to governing authorities because all power is established by God, and resisting such authority is resisting God's ordinance, which carries serious consequences (Romans 13:1-2; Titus 3:1). This submission is not absolute, however, as obedience to God takes precedence over human commands when they conflict, as the apostles declared (Acts 5:29). The call to submit extends beyond civil authorities to mutual submission among believers, motivated by reverence for God (Ephesians 5:21). The carnal mind, opposed to God's law, naturally resists this submission, highlighting the spiritual nature of this obedience (Romans 8:7).
